points.quote: splits into two layers: a generic `framework/` and an AFFiNE-specific `affine/`
Docs are collaborative and CRDT-backed, and the store handles schema, transactions and extensions.
It holds the dependency-injection container, extension system, commands, selection, clipboard, the block and widget view base classes
`widgets/*`: UI overlays such as the slash menu, toolbar, drag handle... `fragments/*`: side panels such as outline, frame-panel, doc-title
`block-suite-editor/` wraps the editor for React, with `lit-adaper.tsx` bridging React and Lit.
